info.body.intro: PoliAule is a web app that helps students find available classrooms across Politecnico di Milano campuses.
info.aboutMe.parag2: Like many of you, I often needed a free classroom for studying, group work, or filling gaps between classes. The official tools make this harder than it should be, requiring logins or checking rooms one by one...
info.body.parag1: Built by students for students, PoliAule is a free, open-source project designed to make finding a place to study, collaborate, or take a break simple. Whether you need a quiet spot, a room with power outlets, or just want to check if your go-to space is free, PoliAule makes it quick and easy.
info.aboutMe.title: About me
info.about.title: About PoliAule
info.aboutMe.parag1: Hi there! I'm Cristian Summa, a software engineer and Politecnico di Milano student.
info.aboutMe.parag3: So I built PoliAule: a simple, user-friendly way to see available classrooms at a glance. The goal is straightforward: save you time and make campus life a bit easier.
